name: What can I do to prevent mold from returning to my air vents after remediation?

mainEntity.name: What can I do to prevent mold from returning to my air vents after remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent mold from returning after remediation, address the root cause of the moisture. Ensure your HVAC system is properly maintained and serviced regularly, including checking for leaks and ensuring proper drainage. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% using dehumidifiers if necessary. Improve ventilation, especially in damp areas. Consider professional duct cleaning every few years and promptly repair any water leaks in your home. Adequate insulation for ductwork can also help prevent condensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold return by controlling indoor humidity, regularly maintaining your HVAC system, addressing any leaks, and ensuring good ventilation.
